source:
@@U03177@@
Why waste time, why linger long
By mingling there with what's unsightly?
Here we 塞壬们 come, so sprightly,
Singing our melodious song
As is right for a 塞壬 throng!

@@U03179@@
(Mocking them in the same melody.)

@@U03180@@
Hurry, force them to the ground,
For hidden in those leaves are found
Talons long, hooked, and hideous,
Which will fall on you perfidious,
Should you lend ears to their sound.

@@U03182@@
Away with hate, away with envy!
In the purest chalice pour we
All the brightest joys there be.
Best of water, best of earth,
Shapes of beauty, shapes of mirth,
Shall be one to welcome thee.

@@U03184@@
What am I hearing?
The latest fashion?
Ah, neat novelties, to be sure!
Voice and string combine to sing,
all intertwining in their rhyming,
one about the other.
It’s lost on me, this warbling.
It tickles my ear,
but fails to move my heart.

@@U03186@@
Ha! Your heart!
Don't flatter yourselft
A shriveled leather pouch is more like it,
to judge by your face.
translation:
@@U03177@@
为何要浪费时间，为何要长久徘徊
与难看的东西混在一起？
我们塞壬人来了，如此活泼，
唱着我们悠扬的歌
塞壬人群正好！

@@U03179@@
（用同样的旋律嘲笑他们。）

@@U03180@@
赶紧把他们按倒在地
因为隐藏在那些叶子中被发现
爪子又长又钩又丑陋，
这将落在你背信弃义的身上，
你应该倾听他们的声音吗？

@@U03182@@
远离仇恨，远离嫉妒！
将我们倒入最纯净的圣杯中
那里有所有最明亮的欢乐。
最好的水，最好的地球，
美丽的形状，欢乐的形状，
将会是一位欢迎你的人。

@@U03184@@
我听到了什么？
最新时尚？
啊，当然是新颖的东西！
声音和弦结合起来唱歌，
一切都交织在押韵中，
一个关于另一个。
我迷失了，这种颤音。
弄得我耳朵发痒
却未能打动我的心。

@@U03186@@
哈！你的心！
别自吹自擂
一个干瘪的皮包更像是它，
从你的脸来判断。
